meta.sourceOfTruth: DM-maintained JSON. The website may generate subscription receipts, but it never marks a membership paid by itself.
meta.tierRule: Lifetime paid Warizon order value determines the buyer rank. Active subscription status determines whether benefits are usable today.
meta.paymentRule: Wario collects subscription payments as purchase-order receipts. The DM verifies payment, then updates this JSON manually. Missed payments suspend benefits but do not erase lifetime tier.

delinquencyRules: Subscription receipts are pending until the DM records payment.
